basic_profile.bio: CuriousVoyager23 is a 29-year-old freelance graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. They have a keen interest in storytelling through digital art, often drawing inspiration from dystopian and post-apocalyptic themes. When not working on client projects, they indulge in watching Korean dramas and exploring indie video games. Despite being an introvert, they enjoy engaging in online communities during late-night hours, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM PST. Currently single, they are passionate about learning new languages and are brushing up on their Korean. They dislike negativity and trolls, preferring positive and constructive discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: CuriousVoyager23 has a background in visual arts, holding a Bachelor’s degree in Fine Arts from a local university. Their knowledge extends to digital design tools like Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop, acquired through both formal education and self-learning via online tutorials. They are well-versed in pop culture, particularly Korean media, due to personal interests and online community interactions.
